sources.section: ISA extensions without a shipped server part
sources.entry: Intel AVX10.2 Architecture Specification - Folds the AVX-512 subsets into one versioned level and adds BF16 and FP8 forms, pending a shipped part and a run.

summary.title: Intel® Advanced Vector Extensions 10.2 (Intel® AVX10.2) Architecture Specification
summary.one_liner: Intel's AVX10.2 page describes the AVX10.2 instruction set architecture, but the page text provided is only a short description with cookie-consent boilerplate, so the technical details are not included here.
takeaways: AVX10.2 is Intel's Advanced Vector Extensions 10.2 instruction set architecture.
The page itself is a download landing page; the spec document is behind a View/Download action.
The provided page text contains only a one-line description and cookie-consent text, so no instruction details are available from it.
The listing notes it folds AVX-512 subsets into one versioned level and adds BF16 and FP8 forms; this is from the listing, not the page text.
summary.summary: This Intel page hosts the Intel Advanced Vector Extensions 10.2 (AVX10.2) Instruction Set Architecture document. The only description in the page text is that the document describes the AVX10.2 ISA, with a 'View' or 'Download' option for the material itself. The rest of the text is browser-upgrade notices and cookie-consent boilerplate, so no technical details could be confirmed from the page. The listing adds that AVX10.2 folds the AVX-512 subsets into one versioned level and adds BF16 and FP8 forms, which is noted as a listing claim rather than verified page content.
